# Contexts captured as golden HTML fixtures.
#
# Format: <fixture-name>  <path>  [# note]
#
# These paths are the ones the committed goldens in ./golden were captured from.
# They point at content restored from the local development export, so they are only
# reproducible where that content exists — adjust them, then re-capture and
# re-promote (see README.md). Capture fails loudly on a missing path, by design.
#
# A note may carry `expect=NNN` for contexts whose correct response is not 200.
#
# Not covered by the current goldens, and worth adding when the content exists:
#   page           /about/                      # adjust: an existing page (page.hbs)
#   br-home        /br/                         # home-br.hbs -> default-br.hbs
#   members-signin /signin/                     # once members/ templates exist
#   post-en        /en/a-post-slug/             # a post in the /en/ collection

home            /                                           # home.hbs (channel template from routes.yaml)
home-paged      /page/2/                                    # requires at least two pages of posts
post-es         /es/que-es-platform-engineering-sre-devops/  # post with feature image, tags and author
post-code       /es/como-desplegar-ghost-en-kubernetes/     # the only context that exercises CodeBlocks/Prism
es-home         /es/                                        # home-es.hbs -> default-es.hbs
tag             /tag/news/                                  # tag.hbs (tag taxonomy)
author          /author/local/                              # author.hbs
not-found       /this-page-does-not-exist/                  # error-404.hbs; expect=404
